info.name: OpenRegister Object Grants API
info.description:
GET /api/objects/{register}/{schema}/{id}/grants, asserted over HTTP (change an-object-lists-its-grants-with-their-origin, tasks 4.4 and 4.5).

FOUR CALLERS: the administrator, the record's owner, a reader who may read the record through a schema rule naming a group, and an outsider who may not read it. Every request carries its own basic auth and sends no cookies (protocolProfileBehavior.disableCookies), and the 'who am I' steps assert the server sees the account each step names.

WHAT IT ASSERTS, each with its control (the reader can read the record, the outsider cannot):
  * /grants answers 404 to the outsider, 403 to the reader and 200 to the owner, and a refusal names nobody
  * the owner's rows are the owner (origin owner) and the group (origin rule, schema level), nobody else; principalTypes keeps only the asked type
  * an unknown record is 404
  * regression: /permissions and /shares give the owner 200 and the reader 403, as before, and the outsider 404

exec: pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'OCS-APIRequest', value: 'true' });

item.name: setUp: the record owner

exec: // Three callers: the owner, a reader through a schema rule, and an outsider who may not read the record. All are removed in tearDown.
const suffix = Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
const password = () => 'Gr4nt!' + suffix + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + 'Zq9';
pm.collectionVariables.set('ownerId', 'or-grants-owner-' + suffix);
pm.collectionVariables.set('ownerPassword', password());
pm.collectionVariables.set('readerId', 'or-grants-reader-' + suffix);
pm.collectionVariables.set('readerPassword', password());
pm.collectionVariables.set('outsiderId', 'or-grants-outsider-' + suffix);
pm.collectionVariables.set('outsiderPassword', password());
pm.collectionVariables.set('groupId', 'or-grants-readers-' + suffix);
pm.test('the owner account is created', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));

item.name: GET the record as the outsider -> 404, the outsider may not read it

exec: pm.test('the outsider cannot read the record', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(404));

item.name: GET .../grants as the outsider -> 404, nothing about the record is told

exec: pm.test('a caller who cannot read the record gets 404', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(404));
pm.test('the answer is JSON, not an error page', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').to.match(/^application\/(problem\+)?json/));

pm.test('the answer names nobody who holds access', () => { const t = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(t).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('ownerId')); pm.expect(t).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('groupId')); });

item.name: GET .../grants as the reader -> 403, reading the record is not reading who holds it

exec: pm.test('a reader without the right gets 403', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(403));
pm.test('the answer is JSON, not an error page', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').to.match(/^application\/(problem\+)?json/));

pm.test('the answer names nobody who holds access', () => { const t = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(t).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('ownerId')); pm.expect(t).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('groupId')); });

item.name: GET .../grants as the owner -> 200, one row per principal and origin

exec: pm.test('the owner gets the rows', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('the rows are about this record', () => pm.expect(body.object).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('objectUuid')));
const owner = body.results.find(r => r.origin === 'owner');

pm.test('the owner holds a row with origin owner', () => { pm.expect(owner, JSON.stringify(body.results)).to.not.be.undefined; pm.expect(owner.principal).to.include({ type: 'user', id: pm.collectionVariables.get('ownerId') }); });
const rule = body.results.find(r => r.origin === 'rule' && r.principal.type === 'group');

pm.test('the group holds a row with origin rule at schema level', () => { pm.expect(rule, JSON.stringify(body.results)).to.not.be.undefined; pm.expect(rule.principal.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('groupId')); pm.expect(rule.level).to.eql('schema'); pm.expect(rule.verbs).to.include('read'); });
pm.test('nobody else is listed', () => pm.expect(body.results.length, JSON.stringify(body.results)).to.eql(2));

item.name: GET .../grants?principalTypes=group as the owner -> only the group rows

exec: pm.test('the owner gets the filtered rows', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200));
const rows = pm.response.json().results;
pm.test('every row is a group', () => { pm.expect(rows.length).to.be.above(0); rows.forEach(r => pm.expect(r.principal.type).to.eql('group')); });
